description: Eight channel stereo mixer. Every channel has a level, a pan, a solo and a mute, each with a control voltage or trigger input, and the master has its own level and mute and a stereo chain input

params.text: Solos that channel, and lights while it is soloed
Mutes that channel, and lights while it is muted
How much of the voltage at that channel's volume CV input reaches its level
How much of the voltage at that channel's pan CV input reaches its pan
Mutes the master output, and lights while it is muted
How much of the voltage at the master volume CV input reaches the master level
Switches the peak meters off, which saves processing
Takes the DC blocking filter out of the signal path so the mixer can mix control voltages rather than audio

inputs.text: The left side of that channel's stereo input. A polyphonic cable into the left input of channel 1 is spread across the channels of the mixer, one voice per channel
The right side of that channel's stereo input
A voltage moving the level of that channel
A voltage moving the pan of that channel
A trigger switches the solo of that channel on and off
A trigger switches the mute of that channel on and off
A voltage moving the master level
A trigger switches the master mute on and off
A signal added to the mixed output on the left, for feeding in the output of another mixer
A signal added to the mixed output on the right, for feeding in the output of another mixer

outputs.text: The left side of the mixed output
The right side of the mixed output
Carries that channel on its own after its level and pan, on the left; these outputs are hidden until the menu shows them
Carries that channel on its own after its level and pan, on the right; these outputs are hidden until the menu shows them

notes: the level and the pan of a channel are set by dragging their displays rather than by a knob, and the level display doubles as a peak meter that turns red when that channel clips
a polyphonic cable into the right input of channel 1 is spread across the channels in the same way as one into the left input, one voice per channel.
menu: INPUT ATTENUATION — an attenuation applied to every channel input: 0dB, -6dB, -12dB or -24dB
LIMITER — the limiter on the master output: No limiter, Hard limit +0dB, Hard limit +3dB, Hard limit +6dB, Soft limit +0dB or Soft limit +3dB
SHOW POST OUTPUTS — adds a left and right output to every channel, carrying that channel alone after its level and pan; HIDE POST OUTPUTS takes them away again
POST OUT won't SOLO — makes the post outputs carry their own channel even while another channel is soloed
Polyphony channels POST OUT Channel 1 — sends every channel of the mixer out of the post output of channel 1 on one polyphonic cable, with the number of channels chosen there
